title: Ranch Of Rescued Hope
specs: Secure Riding Academy uses nationally recognized Secure Seat Method®
Vaulting is safer than riding a bike or playground activities
Riders must be age 5 or older for lessons and vaulting
All riders under 18 required to wear helmet; helmets highly recommended for others
Riders must wear pants and closed-toed, hard soled shoes; no sandals allowed
Vaulting participants must weigh under 190 lbs
All riders must sign a release of liability; minors require parent/guardian signature
Family riding lessons available, time depends on number of riders
Vaulting team lessons with special privileges
includes: Helmet rental included in lesson rates
Pasture board includes daily grain, free choice salt and fresh water
Access to indoor arena, round pen, trail system for boarders
gap: Exact prices for private riding lessons and vaulting lessons not stated
blurb: Guests can take riding lessons in Western or English styles, vaulting lessons, or join the Secure Riding Academy for ages 5 to 18. Training services include on-premise and off-premise horse training in various disciplines. Boarding options include pasture and limited stall board with access to facilities.
extraNote: All rates subject to change · Pre-registration required for Secure Riding Academy and vaulting classes · Arrive on time for scheduled lessons · Training specials not offered in 2026
